author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I can't keep up with my hobby projects built by AI.
I am not saying that I can't keep up reviewing the code, I gave that up a while back
I am saying that I don't spend enough time to play with and enjoy the stuffs AI builds.
It is hobby projects, if I merely generate more code but not having any fun, what is the point?
It is the equivalent of keep buying new toys, but never have time to unbox the toys and play with them.
